additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0396255-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R4 170001813] RFID readers not working CRM:01811000519
additional_info.body:
Hello Ankita,
I only got following answer of the customer:
The DC chargers were only integrated into the ChargePoint dashboard at the end of September, before that you could simply plug the charger into the car and charge. Since the DC chargers were integrated, the RFID readers have not been working. Nothing flashes or is visible.
